output.review_comment: The implementation correctly makes all tests pass and the logic is sound. However, the docstring needs to be updated to document the colon/subtitle behavior. Rule 2 currently states small words are capitalized when they're "the first or the last word of text," but the code also capitalizes small words immediately following a colon (which the test suite requires). This behavior should be explicitly documented in the docstring so future maintainers understand the complete specification. Please update Rule 2 to mention that small words are also capitalized when they appear after a colon (indicating the start of a subtitle).
